scene_timeline.visual_description: Ahmad Alzahabi introduces a green smoothie as his new favorite energy-boosting drink.
scene_timeline.audio_description: I have a new smoothie addiction that will give you energy all day. This is going to be my Suhoor the whole month.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Close-up of three pitted Medjool dates on a white plate; Ahmad warns about checking for mold.
scene_timeline.audio_description: To start, you're going to pit three dates, ensuring there's no mold. I did not know how common that is. I bit into the wrong date once and it was absolutely miserable.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Ahmad slices a small avocado and scoops it into the blender cup, explaining its use in international drinks.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Now if you spend enough time overseas, you'll realize they put avocado in a lot of drinks. So this is currently my new fixation. I've been liking avocado versus banana because it has a little bit more healthy fats and fiber.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Ahmad adds chia seeds, a scoop of vanilla protein powder, milk from a glass jar, and ice cubes to the blender.
scene_timeline.audio_description: I'm going to add a serving of chia seeds or flax seeds, a scoop of protein—I'm doing vanilla—and then we're going to add a cup of milk and last but not least, a couple ice cubes.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Ahmad shakes the blender cup and discusses the high fiber and protein content.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Now all the details are going to be in the description. This is extremely nutritious. Roughly 30 grams of fiber and around 35 grams of protein.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Ahmad places the cup on a Ninja blender base and pulses it.
Ahmad drizzles honey along the inside of a clean glass jar.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Now this is not an extremely sweet drink. There is some sweetness from the dates, but I'm just going to drizzle a little bit of honey when I want to serve it because it's my drink. If it's too sweet, don't add the honey.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Ahmad pours the thick green smoothie into the honey-lined glass and takes a sip.
scene_timeline.audio_description: And now we just pour it in. Baby, she's a beaut. And as always, Bismillah. That's amazing. This is going to be my Suhoor the whole month. Don't get intimidated by the avocado, you're going to love it.

parsed_output.overall_summary: Ahmad Alzahabi (@thegoldenbalance) demonstrates how to make a high-protein, high-fiber green smoothie designed for long-lasting energy, specifically mentioning it as a great option for Suhoor during Ramadan. The recipe features Medjool dates for sweetness, avocado for healthy fats and creaminess, vanilla protein powder, chia seeds, and milk. Ahmad emphasizes checking dates for mold and suggests drizzling honey in the glass for extra sweetness if desired. The video concludes with a taste test and a recommendation not to be intimidated by the use of avocado in a sweet drink.

people.description: Ahmad Alzahabi, a male creator with curly dark hair and a beard, wearing a black t-shirt and an Apple Watch.

takeaways.statement: Avocado is a superior smoothie base compared to banana for those seeking more healthy fats and fiber.
Always check Medjool dates for mold before consuming or blending them.
This specific combination of ingredients provides high fiber (28g) and protein (37g) for sustained energy.
